note: Where each villager's v3 frames (src/art-release-v3/npc/npc.<who>.*.png) were taken from. The ONE place that records it: tools/art_v3/import_npc_v3.mjs reads this file, checks the frames out of the commit named here (the same blobs: the pictures are never edited on this branch) and verifies the result. To replace a person, change its commit here and run `node tools/art_v3/import_npc_v3.mjs`; `--check` only verifies. state: "final" = passed the independent inspection; "provisional" = still being corrected by its artist, to be replaced. Since 2026-11-14 all 9 are final: guard, child, woman, smith, princess from gfx/v3-art 7ea81cf; elder, traveller, cook, merchant from gfx/v3-npc-b e40a6ab (the cook and the merchant were be6bff7, provisional, before; elder and traveller are the same blobs in be6bff7 and e40a6ab).
